title: Creative Lore
description: this is a simple plugin that Adds lore on items when made in creative or dropped picked up in creative to help moderators catch admin abuse
body:
🪶 CreativeLore — Track Creative Origins

CreativeLore automatically adds lore to every item created or picked up in Creative Mode, making it easy to trace an item’s history. When a player spawns or grabs an item from the creative inventory, it’s marked with a line like

Made by ThinkLink and each time it’s picked up again, another line is added: Picked up by ThinkLink

Perfect for servers that want transparency, accountability, or just a touch of personality in their creative builds.

Features

Automatically tags items created in Creative Mode

Appends lore lines for every creative pickup

Works seamlessly with Paper 1.21.1

Lightweight and performance‑friendly

Use Cases

Build tracking for creative worlds

Staff monitoring tools

Personalized item lore for creative builders
